split.partition: per-format common source-time cutoff across cohorts; whole drafts and timestamp ties together; closest legal boundary to 70% of drafts
split.scope: residual only; train first 70%, evaluate last 30%; training-only eligibility, fit, features and transformations; baseline only as preregistered

rules.A: both k2/single-X and k3plus/single-X lower 95% O/E bounds > 1.10

decisions.rules: Original prompt 2 holdout criteria unchanged. If A adopted, stage-interact established_support too.
Original prompt 3 holdout criteria unchanged. Use selected stage feature structure.

Uniform under/over-credit report only; no exponent, temperature, global support scale. Context-specific predeclared correction only, trained on first 70% checked on last 30% across formats. Established second-color issue goes exclusively through A.

Same-format/mode baseline and training-side residual full population; report variance explained by existing card terms and v6 support per format and eligible/ineligible before fitting. Only pick-stage interaction or ALSA value for cards without terms; evaluate on shared residual holdout. Explicitly full-population mostly ordinary-player behavior.

card_arms.selection: score together on one final validation; if multiple alternatives pass their own rules, highest pooled Strict separation

calibration.if_A: both pooled Strict strong k2 and k3plus single-X O/E within [0.90,1.10]
calibration.if_B: pooled Strict strong k1_other_multicolor single-X O/E >= 0.85
calibration.if_A_or_B: k1_gold_MX and k1_mono_X single-X O/E within [0.90,1.15]

acceptance.failure: retain current reviewed refit; no subset rescue, second combination or retuning

superseded_policy: No selection from earlier independent runs. Only compatible code and provably identical residual holdout artifacts may be reused after predecessor feature and split parity; earlier validation comparisons informational only. No original validation access during design.

constraints.concurrency: unique workflow group or cancel-in-progress false; never reuse shared neutral release cancellation group
